en: The postcard depicts a historical painting of a large whale stranded on a riverbank or coastline, surrounded by a crowd of people. In the foreground, there are several women and men in 19th-century Northern European clothing, along with children, engaging in discussion or looking toward the whale. To the right, four men are seated in a rowing boat. In the background, a large group of people gather around the whale, with a bridge and a town visible further back. The architecture suggests a Northern European city.
